dialog: Behold my determination.
If you concede defeat/ I will end this with minimal pain for you.
You didn't think you could get away/ I hope.
I won't let you escape.
I'll strike you down personally!
I will not falter on the field of battle.
I'll show you the might of a guardian of the lunar capital.
I will follow Gensokyo's customs in this.
I will put your strength to the test.
Closing the gap...
Haaah!
Finding the ideal distance...
You're mine!
I won't let you escape!
I have you now!
Prepare....
Prepare... for your end!
If you wish to fight at this distance...
If you wish to fight at this distance... hyaaah!
You intend to stay safe at a distance?
You intend to stay safe at a distance? How optimistic!
I will purify away...
I will purify away... all of your pollution!
This is still in my ideal range!
This is still in my ideal range!
Burn in the flames of divinity.
Divine Sword of Endings...
HI-NO-KAGUTSUCHI!
Burn in the cleansing flame!
The flame that burns hotter than all else!
Face my blade!
You put up no resistance at all. I'm disappointed.
You will realize the strength of the gods.
Divine Hi-no-Kagutsuchi...
Divine Hi-no-Kagutsuchi... enter this blade!
Burn in the cleansing flame!
It's not over yet!
Raaaah!
You're too weak!
Try and withstand this blow!
Come forth/ O god of flames!
Hi-no-Kagutsuchi!
Burn in the cleansing flame!
I won't let you escape!
This is your end!
At least you showed just a little mettle there!
This will happen before you can even blink.
Divine Takemikazuchi/ grant me thy power!
With the speed of lightning!
Haaah!
You're already in striking range!
Haaaaaaah!
This is the power of a god of lightning.
There is very little chance you can keep up with this.
Divine Takemikazuchi... I invite thy presence.
I'll bring you down/ all at once!
I have you now!
Hyaah! Hyaah! Hyaaaaaah!
This is your end!
Once again I have cut a worthless opponent.
I command the powers of the heavens.
Divine Takemikazuchi/ enter this blade!
One strike! One kill!
You're too slow!
I'll settle this in the blink of an eye!
Haaaaaaah!
I wonder if you now understand what the blade of the gods entails.
I will erase all darkness from here.
Ama-no-Iwato...
Ama-no-Iwato... open.
Now/ prostrate yourself before this.
O Great Mother of Brilliant Light...
O Great Mother of Brilliant Light... shine forth.
Come/ O Amaterasu Omikami.
O Light/ Purify all Darkness...
O Light/ Purify all Darkness...
Come/ O Amaterasu Omikami.
Ama-no-Iwato... open.
I will stop to read my opponent's movements.
Perhaps I will assess their power a little longer...
You cannot win fighting like that.
It seems you're hesitant to face me.
Mark my words/ I will repay the debt of honor I now owe.
I will settle this matter myself.
I'll take charge of what remains to be done.
This is also part of my duty.
That was careless of you. Fall back.
You may always rely on me.
Follow me!
I'll accompany you!
I'll make an opening.
I will lead the way for you.
Advance upon them.
Let's coordinate our danmaku!
The power of the gods and my sword will be with you.
We will turn the tide of this battle!
To find myself saved by the shrine maiden of earth...
You missed your mark/ shrine maiden of earth.
Reimu/ I'll take charge of what remains to be done.
You may be a shrine maiden/ but you're an unpracticed one.
Reimu/ are you daydreaming?
With you and me/ this will go well.
Use your powers as a shrine maiden- fire at will!
Leave the vanguard to me/ shrine maiden of earth.
Don't get in the way with those strange movements of yours.
Reimu/ I will contain the enemy for you.
You will have the power of the gods that dwell within me/ Reimu!
Reimu/ the two of us will turn the tide of this battle!
Reimu/ I'll coordinate my danmaku with yours!
To think you would do something like that...
I see you accomplished the diversionary action I needed.
Reisen/ I'll take charge of what remains to be done.
Reisen/ are you heedless of danger and duty?
Whether current or former/\n it also my duty to protect my pets.
Reisen/ I will contain the enemy for you.
Reisen/ I'll accompany you.
Leave the vanguard to me/ Reisen.
There's no need to be so oddly tense.
With you and me/ this will go well.
You will have the power of the gods that dwell within me/ Reisen!
Reisen/ the two of us will turn the tide of this battle!
Reisen/ I'll coordinate my danmaku with yours!
Death to those who have wronged Lady Yagokoro!
If Lady Yagokoro wills it/ it will be done!
Lady Yagokoro/ please leave the remainder to me.
I will not let you harm Lady Yagokoro.
Lady Yagokoro/ please withdraw.
I will lead the way for you/ Lady Yagokoro.
Lady Yagokoro/ please do not push yourself too hard.
Lady Yagokoro/ should it please you/ please refrain from shooting in my direction...
I will advance on them without delay.
Lady Yagokoro/ please let me follow you into battle.
You wlil have my sword at your side/ Lady Yagokoro!
Lady Yagokoro's strategies will turn the tide of this battle!
Lady Yagokoro/ I'll coordinate my danmaku with yours!
I will take revenge for my sister!
Toyohime/ I will slice them apart.
Toyohime/ please leave the remainder to me.
I would never let you harm my sister.
Toyohime/ please withdraw.
I will lead the way for you/ Toyohime.
Toyohime/ I'll head in to battle first.
Please try not to overdo it.
Toyohime/ please don't stray too far from me.
Toyohime/ please don't push yourself too much.
Toyohime/ I will follow you into battle.
Toyohime/ let's show them the Watatsuki way of battle.
Toyohime/ together you and I will turn the tide of this battle!
Toyohime/ I'll coordinate my danmaku with yours.
Reysen/ I will do your bravery justice.
Yes/ do it exactly as we drilled.
Giving it your all? You're improving.
This is a duty of those who stand in the vanguard.
You are lacking in combat experience...
Reysen/ I will accompany you.
If you're a soldier of the Lunar Defense Corps/ then show me!
Reysen/ follow me.
Fulfill your duty as a member of the vanguard/ Reysen.
Reysen/ do it just as you were trained.
Reysen/ my power will be with you.
Reysen/ the two of us will turn the tide of this battle!
Reysen/ I'll coordinate my danmaku with yours.
I can follow all of your danmaku at once.
I had the better read on my opponent.
When blades are drawn in earnest/ there's no room to hold back.
I will credit you for this―You did manage to strike me.
Is just hitting me the best you can do?
Oh/ I suppose I let my guard down a little.
If you're only able to fight like THAT...
How could I/ of all people...
To think you could halt my advance/ even for a moment...
Even though your striving is futile/ you still...
I commend your efforts/ but it's just not enough!
You can't count on coincidences like this to keep happening.
I can't believe it/ you found an opening...
That was faster than I had judged it to be.
Even though I'm not holding back...
Bravo/ that was a good hit.
Merely managing to hit me is no cause for rejoicing.
So you still intend to resist.
It would be regrettable if you started celebrating already.
I can see what you're trying to do.
Far too slow!
Oh/ for the love of―Commit to your attacks!
I have the measure of your movements.
This is one of the tricks to a danmaku battle.
You'd be unfit to make into a soldier.
A fundamentally flawed attack.
Your training is insufficient.
You won't win with brute force alone.
An underwhelming attack at best.
Perhaps there's not even a reason to study your techniques.
What a crude attack.
The outcome is undeniable.
It seems you're no match for me even when you do hit.
There are no dead zones in my defense!
The stains of your impurity will never reach me.
I have an abundance of ways to deal with this.
In one word: Amateurish.
I must say you have done well.
This is an disgraceful loss for me...
I'll acknowledge the beauty of your danmaku.
For now I must return my sword to its sheath.
You will atone for the crime of wounding Lady Yagokoro!
I don't have the slightest idea who you are/ but...
I will cut through these foul phantoms!
No matter whose form you imitate...
You dare trifle with Lady Yagokoro's visage?!
You disrespect her by your very presence.
Though you are but a phantom/ I beg your pardon.
You disrespect her by your very presence.
You dare brandish that fan at me?
You are a far cry from my sister.
I can feel no respect towards the gods you house within yourself.
You have no pride in your skill!
You have not atoned enough!
You have not atoned enough!
If you force such power into yourself...
I do not carry this sword to strike at the already defeated/ but...
The power of dreams?\n Finally/ I have found a worthy rival.
I will defeat you/\n and in doing so discharge my duty.
To display the might of the Yaoyorozu no Kami/\n I will end this here!
The power of dreams?\n Finally/ I have found a worthy rival.
I will defeat you/\n and in doing so discharge my duty.
To display the might of the Yaoyorozu no Kami/\n I will end this here!
Ugh/ this is humiliating...
I suppose this is a chance to face my flaws in person.
Even I can't read your movements/ Toyohime...
I had intended to get back to training for some time now.
I will have you pay for the sin of raising your fists against Lady Yagokoro!
Dwell within me/ O god of flames...
Dwell within me/ O god of flames...
Hi-no-Kagutsuchi/ I invite thy presence!
Burn in the cleansing flame!
I won't leave behind a single speck!
I won't leave behind a single speck!
This was just one of my myriad of techniques!
Have you been training every day?\n I'll check your answer's honesty!
Honestly!\n I see your lack of spine hasn't been fixed yet.
Toyohime/ please allow me to practice with you.
It has been quite some time/ hasn't it?\n Since we last practiced together/ I mean.
